title: fix(plugin-form): a master-detail child with authored inline columns derives its sort field and amount field, so line order persists and the total shows (objectui#11144)
body:
Fixes #11144

Clause-②: no
Why no (carried from the claim, comment 5899521217): an existing derivation applies on one more branch. No schema, prop, type or accepted set moves.

Dispatched implementation, `domain:ui` seat 2, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`. Draft until the seat lands it. Direction: triage comment 5898747830.

## What changed

`MasterDetailForm`'s resolve effect had a separate branch for a detail with a `relationshipField` and an authored `columns` set. That branch only hydrated the column types (`hydrateColumns`), so it never took the `sortField` or the `amountField` that `deriveDetail` picks for every other detail. A child whose relationship field declares `inlineColumns` reaches the form through `attachInlineSubforms` exactly that way (it carries `inlineColumns` as `columns` and `inlineAmountField` as `amountField`, nothing else), and the spec has no inline sort-field key. So the showcase invoice line stamped no `position` on create or drag, and with no `inlineAmountField` neither the grid total nor the Subtotal / Tax / Total stack rendered.

- **One derivation.** Both branches now share one `deriveDetail` call. With `relationshipField` given it never throws on the FK, and with `columns` given its `columns` is `hydrateColumns(d.columns, childSchema)` and its amount rule runs over those columns. No second copy of the sort-field or the amount rule, and `deriveMasterDetail.ts` is untouched: nothing needed exporting.
- **The authored-columns branch** still keeps the authored columns, order and labels, and its own `formFields` / `inlineMode` (the derived ones are discarded, as before). What it now takes from the derivation is `sortField` and `amountField`.
- **Authored wins.** `d.amountField ?? derived.amountField` and `d.sortField ?? derived.sortField`, the precedence the derive branch already had. `amountFieldDef` (the totals currency from objectui#11132) follows the resolved `amountField`.
- No fetch is added: the branch already loaded the child schema to hydrate the columns. `deriveDetail` also computes form fields and the inline mode there, which are discarded; both are pure reads of that loaded schema.

## Pins

`MasterDetailForm.inlineColumnsSortAmount-11144.test.tsx`: the showcase invoice line's shape (identity-only `{ name }` columns, a `position` number field that is not a column, a computed currency `amount`, a header `tax_rate`), with the subform written as `attachInlineSubforms` builds it. Each case enters two lines (A: 2 x 5, B: 1 x 3), drags B above A, reads the totals stack and saves.

- the `inlineColumns` subform persists `position` 0 for B and 1 for A, and the stack's subtotal reads 13.00;
- CONTROL: the same child with no `inlineColumns` (the derive branch) gives the same result;
- an authored `amountField` (`inlineAmountField`) wins: the subtotal reads 8.00 from `unit_price`, not 13.00;
- an authored `sortField` wins: `line_no` is stamped and `position` is absent.

## Verification (final HEAD `e14eea2d0`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), then `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` in the same locked run: exit 0, `Test Files 149 passed (149)`, `Tests 1746 passed | 1 skipped (1747)`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` names the new test file. Dependency closure built first (`@object-ui/components^...`, then components, permissions, providers, fields) so the test project reads fresh `.d.ts`.
- **Red before the fix.** The new file on unmodified code (the fix not yet written): 2 failed, 2 passed. The showcase case read `position` undefined; the authored-amount case read `position` undefined.
- **Ablation at the committed fix** (through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proves the anchor hit and the restore): the authored-columns config line set back to `{ ...d, columns: derived.columns }` (the pre-fix config). Result: 2 failed, 2 passed. The showcase case read `lines [B, undefined], [A, undefined]` and `subtotal: null`; the authored-amount case read `position` undefined. Control and authored-sort stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Precedence ablation:** `d.sortField ?? derived.sortField` swapped to `derived.sortField ?? d.sortField`. Only the authored-sort pin went red (`line_no` undefined). Restored the same way.
- **eslint, narrowed to the two changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files:** 0 errors, 23 warnings, all in `MasterDetailForm.tsx`. The base version of that file, linted through `--stdin`, also has 23. Evidence for the narrowing:
  - the population is the root flat config's `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` block, which the package `lint` script (`eslint .`) applies;
  - the `--format json` count is 2 files;
  - it is invariant for untouched files: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` (no type-aware linting), and the custom rules in `eslint-rules/` read no files, so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-control-bytes.mjs`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` (0 new), `check-changeset-claims.mjs`, `check-pending-changeset-literals.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, and `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`: all exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the three paths reports NOT GOVERNED.
- **Declared narrowing:** the published surface of `@object-ui/plugin-form` is byte-unchanged: no export, type or prop moved, and `hydrateColumns` was only dropped from this file's own import. So no importer's tests are owed. The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **A numeric authored column now yields a total.** A grid with authored columns and no `inlineAmountField` now gets the amount the derive branch always picked from its columns. A column set whose only numeric column is a quantity sums that quantity, exactly as a derived grid of the same child does. This is the ruled "same derivation", not a new rule.
- **A sort field listed as a cell.** If the authored columns list the sort field itself as a cell, the grid now stamps it on every change, over whatever was typed. Derived columns never include sort-named fields. The showcase leaves `position` out of `inlineColumns` on purpose, and no producer was measured listing it.
- **The fully typed branch is untouched.** A detail with a `relationshipField` and every column typed loads no child schema, so it still derives neither field. An uncommitted probe (the same fixture, with all four columns typed) persisted `[["B","ABSENT"],["A","ABSENT"]]` with `subtotal: null`. The spec admits `type` on `inlineColumns` entries (`InlineGridColumnSchema`), but the only measured producer, the showcase, is identity-only. The pending objectui#11132 changeset already names the same no-fetch limit for the currency. Closing it means fetching the child schema for fully configured entries, which is a behaviour choice and not a mechanical extension, so it is not done here. Carrier: none.
